excerpt: Canada Moves Toward Employer Portability for Vulnerable Open Work Permit Holders By Anuj Sengar, Licensed RCIC R515178 · Founder, Can X GlobalPublished: August 2025 · 4 min read Canada is gradually expanding employment flexibility for foreign workers who hold open work permits under vulnerable worker protections. Recent policy changes are making it easier for these individuals to change employers when they face risky or abusive situations. This blog explains what these changes mean, who benefits, and how affected workers can apply. What Is an Open Work Permit for Vulnerable Workers?
